title: Used to love it
body: We used to love Wunderlist, before it was bought by Microsoft and rebranded. As usual, Microsoft made a mess of it and now it crashes all the time. Time to find an alternative.
author: Estiedi

title: More kanban
body:
I’m doing the getting things done method from David Allen where one needs to move the tasks around to different boxes. It would be helpful to be able to move the tasks easier from one list to another and view the lists next to each other, like columns in a Kanban board. 
For this reason I moved to Trello now, which gives me that, but which is not so good with repeated tasks. If you could give me that view and the possibility to move the tasks, also per automation, as in “If a tasks becomes due it automatically moves to the ‘Urgent’ board.”
author: ol___r

title: My daily task manager with some issues
body:
I use Microsofts To Do app on daily basis to get my stuff done and love it.

Although I do get some not breaking but annoying issues.
If the app was open in background for a long time (can’t say how long I haven’t measured it) it won’t allow me to tap the task in my list to edit it, nothing happens until I restart the application.

Another rather annoying issue is the suggestion feature on the today list which works sometimes fine and sometimes it suggests me tasks that are already on the today list due to a due date set on them to next day and so if I open up the suggestion list on the next day I see the task again.
Clicking it will also make it disappear from the today list of instead not even showing it.
Also another issue which is a visual problem, the list in the suggestion sometimes has dimension problems with the list items which are overlapping after pressing the “more” button multiple times. The list might sometimes even crash and disappear.

If you could look into this if other people might have this issues too.
I think this app deserves a 5 star rating if it wasn’t for these annoying bugs.

author: ebo22365

title: Rendez-nous Wunderlist!
body:
Problèmes rencontrés depuis que Wunderlist est devenu MS to-do:

- difficultés à déplacer précisément les éléments, tout défilé trop rapidement. Pouvez-vous faire pour que ce soit aussi précis que ça l'était dans Wunderlist?
- à cause de cela, on glisse souvent par erreur des éléments de la liste sur un autre élément, ce qui en fait un sous-élément. Est-ce que vous pouvez désactiver cette fonctionnalité?

Nous sommes très déçus par cette nouvelle application alors que nous utilisions Wunderlist depuis des années sans aucun problème. Si les problèmes ne sont pas réglés nous allons chercher une nouvelle application pour remplacer MS to-do
